meta.name: keyless-wiring-test
meta.description: For suites that assert server wiring and never run a codon. The pi passthrough model below is real (the startup self-test now verifies models against pi's catalog) but its provider is not credential-enforced, so the self-test passes with no API keys in the environment — which is what lets these suites live in the keyless offline tier. Never autostart a run against this config: with no DEEPSEEK_API_KEY the codon would fail at spawn.

hank.name: Codon 1: Never Invoked
hank.promptText: This codon must never run. If you are reading this, a wiring-only test autostarted its config.

hank.name: Codon 2: Never Invoked
hank.promptText: This codon must never run either.
